name: agent-glasses

commands.title: Agent Glasses: Turn Phone Access On/Off

agentGlasses.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a Claude Code session finishes its turn.

agentGlasses.sound.description: Play a sound when a Claude Code session needs your permission or input.

agentGlasses.contextWindow.description: Context window, in tokens, the context gauge measures against.

agentGlasses.diskWarnGb.description: Warn when free disk space drops below this many GB (red below two thirds of it).

agentGlasses.celebrate.description: Briefly celebrate real outcomes: a commit landing, tests going green again, a subagent finishing cleanly, an achievement.

agentGlasses.budget.dailyUsd.description: Daily budget in USD at API prices (0 = off). Warns at 80% and 100%.

agentGlasses.budget.monthlyUsd.description: Monthly budget in USD at API prices (0 = off). Warns at 80% and 100%.

agentGlasses.phone.port.description: Port for phone access (HTTPS on your Wi-Fi address only).

agentGlasses.phone.autoOffHours.description: Phone access turns itself off after this many hours.

description: See what your Claude Code agents are doing: live sessions and subagents, costs, usage limits, insights, history and a read-only phone page.
